    -- LawfulPermanentResident : ResidentAlien content LawfulPermanentResident

signals.description: § 7701(b)(1)(B) requires the individual to be 'neither a citizen of the United States nor a resident' to qualify as a nonresident alien. AlienStatus carries no citizen variant, so the NonResident branch maps to NonresidentAlien regardless of is_citizen_of_united_states — incorrect when a US citizen fails all three tests in (A). The input is declared but cannot be wired into a correct rule body until the enum is extended or the scope is restricted to non-citizens.
signals.option_a: Extend AlienStatus with a Citizen variant; wire is_citizen_of_united_states into the NonResident branch so citizens produce Citizen rather than NonresidentAlien.
signals.option_b: Treat AlienStatusDetermination as applicable only to non-citizens (enforce is_citizen_of_united_states = false as a precondition at the calling scope); citizen classification resolved upstream before this scope is invoked.

declaration scope SubstantialPresenceTest:
  input days_current_year content integer
  input days_first_preceding_year content integer
  input days_second_preceding_year content integer
  input excluded_days_current_year content integer
  input excluded_days_first_preceding_year content integer
  input excluded_days_second_preceding_year content integer
  input has_tax_home_in_foreign_country content boolean
  input closer_connection_to_foreign_country content boolean
  input had_application_for_adjustment_of_status_pending content boolean
  input took_steps_to_apply_for_lawful_permanent_resident_status content boolean
  internal effective_days_current_year content integer
  internal effective_days_first_preceding_year content integer
  internal effective_days_second_preceding_year content integer
  internal weighted_days content decimal
  internal closer_connection_exception_applies content boolean
  output meets_test content boolean

scope PresenceDayExclusion:
  definition day_excluded_from_presence_count equals
    is_exempt_individual or
    (medically_unable_to_leave and
     medical_condition_arose_in_united_states)

scope SubstantialPresenceTest:

definition effective_days_current_year equals
    days_current_year - excluded_days_current_year

definition effective_days_first_preceding_year equals
    days_first_preceding_year - excluded_days_first_preceding_year

definition effective_days_second_preceding_year equals
    days_second_preceding_year - excluded_days_second_preceding_year

definition weighted_days equals
    decimal of effective_days_current_year +
    (decimal of effective_days_first_preceding_year) / 3. +
    (decimal of effective_days_second_preceding_year) / 6.

definition meets_test equals
    effective_days_current_year >= 31 and
    weighted_days >= 183.

definition closer_connection_exception_applies equals
    effective_days_current_year < 183 and
    has_tax_home_in_foreign_country and
    closer_connection_to_foreign_country

exception definition closer_connection_exception_applies
    under condition
      had_application_for_adjustment_of_status_pending or
      took_steps_to_apply_for_lawful_permanent_resident_status
    consequence equals false

exception definition meets_test
    under condition closer_connection_exception_applies
    consequence equals false

signals.condition: day_excluded_from_presence_count is true under PresenceDayExclusion for a given day in the first preceding year
